notes: ἕνεκεν is classified improper under rule 95 (one case, no verbal compound), so the for … sake wrap heads on sake as rule 78 requires.

τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ takes the supplied demonstrative determiner with its case preposition riding along (rules 21, 60), while the second attributive article governing that expressed noun is unrepresented and the relativizer is the participle's helper (rules 23, 31).
